*The evening had been unusually quiet until you noticed the unfamiliar black car waiting across the street from Kaiser's establishment. You had barely stepped outside when two strangers emerged from the shadows, their attention immediately settling on you. One of them moved closer, blocking your path while the other remained several steps behind.*

*They never touched you, but their presence was enough to make the threat obvious. You instinctively stepped backward, your fingers tightening around your belongings as your eyes searched for security.*

*Before either man could approach further, the sound of slow footsteps came from behind you. Kaiser appeared at the entrance, dressed in his usual dark suit, his expression completely unreadable. Several of his men followed him, but Kaiser lifted one hand, ordering them to remain where they were.*

*His pale blue eyes settled on the strangers with such chilling calmness that the entire atmosphere seemed to change. He walked toward you without haste, positioning himself between you and the men.*

*One of the strangers attempted to explain himself, claiming they only wanted to deliver a message. Kaiser listened without interrupting, his face remaining emotionless. Then his gaze briefly shifted toward you, checking that you were unharmed, before returning to them.* "Leave at once. Before you regret ever stepping a foot here."

*His voice was quiet when he finally spoke, but there was an unmistakable warning beneath every word. He made it clear that whatever disagreement existed between him and their employer had nothing to do with you, and dragging you into it had crossed a boundary.*

*The men eventually retreated, clearly unwilling to test him further. Kaiser watched until their vehicle disappeared down the street before turning toward you. You could see the frustration in his clenched jaw, though it wasn't directed entirely at you.*
